blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 量具重複性與再現性 (GR&R, Gauge Repeatability and Reproducibility)：衡量測量系統誤差佔公差範圍百分比的指標。GR&R ≤ 20%意味著測量工具的不確定性不超過公差的20%，確保測量結果能真實反映產品品質。這是MSA（量測系統分析）的核心概念。
blocks.en: Gauge Repeatability and Reproducibility (GR&R): An index that expresses measurement system error as a percentage of the tolerance range. GR&R ≤ 20% means the uncertainty of the measuring tool does not exceed 20% of the tolerance, ensuring that measurement results truly reflect product quality. This is a core concept of MSA (measurement system analysis).

blocks.zh: ISO 15378：專為藥品初級包裝材料設計的質量管理體系標準，是在ISO 9001基礎上加入GMP要求的特定版本。這意味著玻璃管筒供應商不僅需要ISO 9001認證，更理想的是符合ISO 15378。
blocks.en: ISO 15378: A quality management system standard designed specifically for primary packaging materials for medicinal products; it is a version of ISO 9001 with GMP requirements added. This means a glass barrel supplier needs not only ISO 9001 certification but, ideally, compliance with ISO 15378.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: GR&R的實際意義：若玻璃管筒外徑公差為±0.1 mm（範圍0.2 mm），測量儀器的GR&R需 ≤ 0.04 mm（20%×0.2）。超標的GR&R意味著你無法區分「真實的產品變異」和「測量誤差」，導致誤放行或誤退貨。
blocks.en: The practical meaning of GR&R: If the outer diameter tolerance of a glass barrel is ±0.1 mm (a range of 0.2 mm), the GR&R of the measuring instrument must be ≤ 0.04 mm (20% × 0.2). An excessive GR&R means you cannot distinguish "true product variation" from "measurement error", leading to wrongful release or wrongful rejection.

blocks.zh: 電子記錄可靠性：直接引用了21 CFR Part 11的精神，強調電子記錄和電子簽名的可信性。這對於在無紙化生產環境中使用ERP/MES系統的CDMO至關重要。
blocks.en: Reliability of electronic records: This directly echoes the spirit of 21 CFR Part 11, stressing the trustworthiness of electronic records and electronic signatures. It is essential for CDMOs that use ERP/MES systems in a paperless manufacturing environment.

blocks.zh: Part 4 Clause 5 — Syringe Barrel: Dimensions and Performance Part 4 Clause 5 — 注射筒筒身：尺寸與性能
blocks.en: Part 4 Clause 5 — Syringe Barrel: Dimensions and Performance

blocks.zh: Luer錐頭系統 (Luer Cone / Luer Lock)：6%錐度的標準連接系統，允許注射管筒與針頭、靜脈輸液系統等設備連接。Luer（無鎖定）靠摩擦力固定；Luer Lock（帶鎖定）有螺旋鎖定機構，更安全。ISO 80369-7是最新的國際標準，逐步取代舊的ISO 594系列。
blocks.en: Luer Cone System (Luer Cone / Luer Lock): A standard connection system with a 6% taper that allows the syringe barrel to be connected to needles, IV infusion systems and other devices. A Luer (slip) fitting is held by friction; a Luer Lock has a threaded locking mechanism and is more secure. ISO 80369-7 is the latest international standard and is gradually replacing the older ISO 594 series.

blocks.zh: Type I玻璃（一類玻璃）：最高等級的藥用玻璃，具有最強的水解抗性（HGA 1）。適用於幾乎所有注射劑，特別是pH敏感或容易與玻璃反應的藥品。Type II玻璃僅適用於水溶液，Type III僅適用於固體製劑。預填充注射器必須使用Type I玻璃。
blocks.en: Type I glass: The highest grade of pharmaceutical glass, with the strongest hydrolytic resistance (HGA 1). It is suitable for almost all injectables, especially drugs that are pH-sensitive or prone to reacting with glass. Type II glass is suitable only for aqueous solutions, and Type III only for solid dosage forms. Prefilled syringes must use Type I glass.

blocks.zh: 琥珀色玻璃 (Amber Glass)：通過添加氧化鐵和硫化亞鐵製成，能阻擋290-450 nm波長的光線，保護光敏感藥品（如某些生物製劑、維生素）。透明玻璃適用於需要直接觀察藥液外觀的產品。
blocks.en: Amber Glass: Made by adding iron oxide and iron sulphide, it blocks light in the 290-450 nm wavelength range and protects light-sensitive drugs (such as certain biologics and vitamins). Clear glass is suitable for products where the appearance of the solution must be inspected directly.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 玻璃注射管筒的Luer錐頭就像電源插座的標準化接口——全球統一的6%錐度設計確保不同廠家的針頭都能與注射管筒可靠連接，而不需要適配器。但玻璃的成型工藝不像注塑那麼精密，表面有「波浪紋」，所以必須用塑膠（而非金屬）測試件來評估功能性，就像用柔性接口測試而非剛性標準件。
blocks.en: The Luer cone of a glass syringe barrel is like a standardised power socket: the globally uniform 6% taper ensures that needles from different manufacturers connect reliably to the barrel without an adapter. However, glass forming is not as precise as injection moulding and the surface has "waviness", so functionality must be assessed with plastic (not metal) gauges, like testing with a flexible connector rather than a rigid standard piece.

blocks.zh: 凸緣斷裂抗力 (Flange Breakage Resistance)：玻璃注射管筒的凸緣（Finger Flange）是握持和操作的關鍵部位，尤其在自動注射裝置（Auto-injector）中承受更大的機械應力。ISO 11040-4要求進行凸緣斷裂測試，但具體限值由製造商和客戶協商——這意味著在CDMO引入新藥品包裝時，必須明確定義這個關鍵機械性能指標。
blocks.en: Flange Breakage Resistance: The finger flange of a glass syringe barrel is a key part for gripping and handling, and it bears even greater mechanical stress in auto-injectors. ISO 11040-4 requires a flange breakage test, but the specific limit is agreed between manufacturer and customer. This means that when a CDMO introduces a new drug packaging, this critical mechanical performance attribute must be clearly defined.

blocks.zh: 內表面矽化 (Inner Surface Siliconization)：在玻璃內表面塗覆微量矽油以降低活塞塞的滑動阻力。矽化量過少→活塞塞難以推動（Break-Loose Force過高）；矽化量過多→矽油可能遷移入藥品，需符合藥典對矽油的限量要求。
blocks.en: Inner Surface Siliconization: A trace amount of silicone oil is applied to the inner glass surface to reduce the sliding resistance of the plunger stopper. Too little silicone makes the plunger stopper hard to move (break-loose force too high); too much silicone may allow the oil to migrate into the drug product and must comply with the pharmacopoeial limits for silicone oil.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh:
凸緣斷裂抗力測試 (Annex C.1)：
  施加彎曲力矩至凸緣直至斷裂
  記錄斷裂力（N）
  作為生產監控和設計驗證基準

Luer錐頭功能測試（用塑膠參考接頭）：
  液體洩漏測試
  分離力測試（針頭拔出力）
  旋轉力矩測試（Luer lock）
  → 不使用金屬參考接頭（玻璃表面特性不兼容）
blocks.en:
Flange breakage resistance test (Annex C.1):
  Apply a bending moment to the flange until it breaks
  Record the breaking force (N)
  Use as a baseline for production monitoring and design verification

Luer cone functional tests (using plastic reference connectors):
  Liquid leakage test
  Separation force test (needle pull-off force)
  Unscrewing torque test (Luer lock)
  → Do not use metal reference connectors (glass surface characteristics are incompatible)
